summary: 已检查全览和全部 31 张原生 1:1 裁片；栏杆、榻足和真实左右鞋窗口未见明确大幅重影、错位断线或硬边矩形曝光块。
纸边红印存在明显软边，不能以 Quality Gate pass 推导整幅处处清晰；未取得配准后的最佳焦点 RAW 证据，不将软边直接归因融合。
下边缘阶梯、上方缺口和右下外边缘不完整 coverage 仍存在；3 张 coverage 裁片的黑色区域是 alpha=0。
TIFF 没有 ExtraSamples tag，属于未解决的导出互操作缺陷；因此不能宣布完整原生 TIFF 验收通过。

open_findings.evidence: SamplesPerPixel=4 and RGBA16 coverage channel exists, ExtraSamples(338) absent.
open_findings.impact: Downstream TIFF alpha interpretation is not established.
Output is not a complete rectangle of artwork coverage.

open_findings.evidence: left-red-seal, left-small-seal, right-red-seal and boundary-report crops
open_findings.impact: Cannot claim every fine stroke is optimally focused.

limitations: 只覆盖 31 个选定的原生像素窗口和一张缩小全览，不是对 15701×6585 每个像素、所有 station 接缝的穷尽检查。
报告的 boundary 示例只保留 bounded prefix；4 个上下文均来自该前缀，不能代表全图 seam。
fusion.low_sharpness_regions 的坐标属于 station 局部空间；报告缺少最终 station→world 映射，未假称逐区定位与验证这些低清晰区。
未执行配准后的最佳焦点 RAW patch 对照，印章软边、织纹差异和纸折痕的成因未定；不能宣称处处清晰或融合优于每个源图。
本批 9 个输入中 DSC_6484.NEF 被 registration 排除，仅 8 个有效来源；这不是全部 9 个来源成功参与的验收。
外边缘 coverage 台阶及未覆盖缺口保留；3 个 alpha 抽样 crop 证明当地黑色显示来自 alpha=0，但不能据此认定整图所有黑像素均透明。
TIFF 缺少 ExtraSamples(338) tag；第四通道覆盖数据存在、FFmpeg 可读，不代表所有 TIFF 查看器/下游正确识别透明度。
原生裁片存储 RGBA16，view_image/display 可能以 8 位显示；只缩小全览，31 个原生裁片没有 resize。
没有逐像素比对全部实际 TIFF crop 与源 TIFF；使用 exact integer crop、16-bit header 校验和合成 RGBA16 保真试验作为裁剪方式证据。
本 review 直接查看 cold TIFF 的裁片。cold/hot 是否可以共用检查结果由父任务的完整文件 SHA 审核决定；本 review 不独立宣称冷热文件相等。
Quality Gate pass、native test pass 或冷热文件相同都不替代 degraded ledger、视觉范围和导出格式缺陷的验收。
next_acceptance_work: 补齐 TIFF ExtraSamples 元数据并验证下游透明度解释。
将最终 station→world 映射或可直接复核的低清晰区输出坐标写入报告，补低清晰区定向 review。
对软印章和关键细笔画做最佳焦点 RAW patch 对照，区分素材/焦点与融合影响。
单独调查 DSC_6484 排除原因，扩展 coverage 与所有来源参与的验收。

limitations: Fixed crops are a sample, not every output pixel.
Reported boundary examples are a bounded prefix, not all seam coordinates.
Fusion low_sharpness_regions lack final station-to-world mapping in this report and are not misinterpreted as canvas coordinates.
PNG viewing may use an 8-bit display, but exported crop samples remain 16-bit.

remaining_work.issue: TIFF SamplesPerPixel=4 but ExtraSamples tag338 is absent
remaining_work.next_step: Use existing direct tiff encoder RGB16/RGB8 plus UnassociatedAlpha extra sample; preserve ICC, bit depth and pixel values; do not append extra sample to RGBA16. Test IFD declaration and pixel roundtrip before real-data acceptance.

remaining_work.issue: DSC_6484.NEF is excluded by unchanged native registration support gate
remaining_work.next_step: Investigate scale-dependent patch/support coordinates and native correspondence distribution; preserve coverage threshold and source evidence.

remaining_work.issue: SourceRenderCache evicts full native sources repeatedly, RAW decode=70 per run
remaining_work.next_step: Optimize source request order and retention/shared or tiled representation within an explicit total memory budget; eight native RGB32F sources exceed existing 4GiB source-cache maximum.

remaining_work.issue: MTF and boundary have no eligible content; exact low-sharpness-to-output mapping incomplete
remaining_work.next_step: Preserve N/A and degradation; export final station mapping/boundary evidence for targeted source-versus-output visual validation.

31 native lossless windows and an overview were inspected; not exhaustive per-pixel inspection.
TIFF byte identity proves identical output files; alpha interpretation across decoders remains invalid without tag338.
Nine input files decode successfully, but only eight sources contribute accepted native source evidence.
